title: What's the body holding?
subtitle: No person needed — just a sensation.

steps.body:
You don't need a trigger for this.

Sometimes something is there — in the chest, the gut, the shoulders — without a name or a story yet.

This is just a few minutes to notice what the body is carrying.

steps.title: Where in your body is it?
steps.body: Anywhere that feels tighter, heavier, or more awake than usual.

steps.title: If that sensation had a quality — a word, an emotion, a texture — what would it be?
steps.body: Not what caused it. Just what it feels like.

steps.title: How present is it?
steps.body: Not good or bad — just the intensity right now.

steps.title: What might it be pointing at?
steps.body: You don't have to know. This is just a question to sit with.

exit.body: That's enough. You let something surface — that's the work.
